name: Dinliminate
photoPolicy: existing verified quality photo > Google Places > official restaurant > exact venue > OSM > no card
restaurantInfoPolicy: Google first on detail enrichment > official restaurant website > verified venue data > unknown
googleHardStops: photos:900; text-search-pro:4500; nearby-search-pro:4500; text-search-enterprise:900; nearby-search-enterprise:900; place-details-enterprise:900; place-details-essentials:9000
imageCache: source-aware restaurant photo cache v8; Google media not persisted
restaurantFilters: Cuisine + Open Now (All/Open Now/Closed Now) + Radius; Open Now uses explicit current-hours data or validated opening hours without opening Details
googleBudgetTracker: single durable Neon SKU tracker; legacy photo usage migrated into place-photo
restaurantSearchCore: strict server-side query match + same-place naming dedupe + stale-target protection
